patch_description: Replace the fixed exponentially weighted moving average with a causal, robust adaptive alpha-beta filter. The filter maintains both a level and velocity state, so it predicts the next value before incorporating a measurement; this reduces phase lag relative to a moving average. Its gains increase during sustained high-slope motion to preserve genuine dynamics, while a robust innovation scale clips isolated outliers and reduces noise-driven directional reversals. A slowly smoothed velocity estimate provides trend persistence without requiring a future-looking window, preserving real-time operation and the existing endpoint-aligned output contract.
